en.bdb: How to deal with a fool

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਛਾਵ ਨ ਧੁਪਾ।
verses.translit_en: je moorakh samajhaieeaai samajhai naahee chhaav na dhupaa|

en.bdb: Even if told about the shade and the sunshine, the fool does not understand it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀਂ ਪਰਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਪਿਤਲ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੈਹਾਂ ਰੁਪਾ।
verses.translit_en: akhee(n) parakh na jaaniee pital suinaa kaihaa(n) rupaa|

en.bdb: With his eyes he cannot distinguish between brass and bronze or gold and silver.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਲ ਘਿਅ ਧਰਿਆ ਕੋਲਿ ਘੜੋਲਾ ਕੁਪਾ।
verses.translit_en: saau na jaanai tel ghia dhariaa kol ghaRolaa kupaa|

en.bdb: He can not know the difference of taste between the pot of ghee and an oil vessel.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤੁਲਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰਾ ਘੁਪਾ।
verses.translit_en: surat vihoonaa raat dhih chaanan tul anheraa ghupaa|

en.bdb: Day and night he is devoid of consciousness and to him light and darkness are the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਥੋਮ ਦੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕੁਲੀ ਅਧਉੜੀ ਤੁਪਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaas kathooree thom dhee mihar kulee adhauRee tupaa|

en.bdb: Fragrance of musk and odour of garlic or stiching of velvet and hide are the same for him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਕੁਰੰਗੁ ਅਛੁਪਾ।
verses.translit_en: vairee mitr na samajhiee ra(n)g sura(n)g kura(n)g achhupaa|

en.bdb: He does not identify a friend and an enemy and remains completely unconcerned towards the bad or good colour (of life).
Silence is the best in the company of fool.
